assets.name: Saathi
assets.subject: An eagle head and upper breast, three-quarter profile facing right. Distinct hooked beak, powerful brow and layered neck feathers, beak closed. Natural proportions, dignified and watchful, not angry. This is Saathi's eagle identity.

assets.name: Drishti
assets.subject: A grey wolf's head and upper chest, nearly frontal three-quarter pose slightly facing right. Pointed upright ears, elongated natural muzzle, closed mouth, layered angular fur. Alert and composed, no snarl, no cartoon grin, not a dog or fox. This is Drishti's wolf identity.

assets.name: Disha
assets.subject: An Asian elephant's head and upper shoulders, three-quarter view slightly facing right. Broad recognisable ears, natural small eyes, a clearly visible gently descending trunk and subtle short tusks. Wise and composed, true elephant anatomy, not a cute baby. Keep the complete trunk visible within the square. This is Disha's elephant identity.
